symbols.docstringSummary: Toggles PPU Y-scroll and player sprite X offset every 8 frames to produce screen shake until step counter wraps to zero.
Runs the bank-0 hazard damage and effect update routine and switches UNROM back to PRG bank 6.
Restores UNROM PRG bank 6 via unrom_select_bank_index after bank-0 room handler execution.
Ticks periodic player health drain, places 4 hazard sprite coordinates from bank-0 tables, and cycles effect tiles 0x90/0x91.
Runs the boss vertical hover animation and SFX update and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.
Cycles actor sprite 0 between 0x92 and 0x93, oscillates its Y coordinate via state counter 0x55, and plays SFX 0x30 at turnaround points.
Runs timed room explosion updates and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.
Advances up to 4 blast timers in 0x07DA, runs player hit checks, and expands blast tile clearing every 16 frames up to 0x40.
Adds an 8-bit unsigned offset to the 16-bit big-endian PPU address cursor in zero-page 0x8D and 0x8E.
Queues 4 border-clearing runs and clears matching tiles in 0x0400 for an expanding blast area sized by zero-page 0x8F.
Writes a zero end-of-queue sentinel at the specified offset in the 0x0740 VRAM transfer queue.
Zeroes a horizontal or vertical run of room layout tiles in 0x0400 and appends the matching clear command to the VRAM queue.
Tests active hazard bounding boxes against Snake's coordinates, applying instant death, triggering cutscene state in room 0xBD, or starting
Executes pattern-indexed room hazard updates and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.
Executes pseudo-random room hazard updates and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.
Selects a pseudo-random hazard pattern index from the frame counter and executes pattern-based hazard spawning and collision checks.
Places room hazard sprites from table 0xB890, checks Snake hitbox overlap to trigger alert alarm SFX 0x49, or spawns an alert guard.
Updates the moving bridge platforms and pitfall check and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.
Animates 6 moving bridge platform slots and triggers a fatal pitfall transition to room 5 if Snake is outside safe bounds.
Runs hazard zone and palette-cycling updates and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.
Runs room hazard zone collision checks when active and queues a cycling 16-byte PPU palette write at 0x3F00 every 4 frames.
Checks Snake against room hazard rectangles in table 0xBAA7 to deal periodic damage and detects projectile type 0x29 hits to clear hazard st
Points zero-page 0x80 to bank-0 PPU stream 0xBB3A and uploads two consecutive immediate nametable segments.
Ticks the countdown timer and HUD update routine and restores UNROM PRG bank 6.
Decrements the 16-bit countdown timer in 0x07D7-0x07D8 every 4 frames, formats 4 decimal HUD tiles at PPU 0x232D, or zeroes health at timeou
Stores the given timer or cutscene phase value into zero-page variable 0x67.
Shifts an entry in bank-0 table 0xB01E left by one bit before hitting unparsed data (bank-6 audio stub alias).
Inspects equipment flags in zero-page 0x75 and returns without side effects in C output.
Validates actor slot bounds, empty slot state, and active alert flag before falling into room guard spawning.
Loads an alert-reinforcement guard position for the active room from 0xA7C4 into the actor pool and triggers alert audio.
Alternately queues the equipped weapon or item label and its 3-digit BCD ammo count into the bottom status-bar VRAM queue.
Copies a length-prefixed HUD item or weapon string via zero-page 0x80 into the 0x0740 VRAM queue and zero-pads to 15 bytes.
Initializes the VRAM transfer queue header for a horizontal status-bar write to PPU nametable page 0x23.
Formats a single BCD digit into tile 0x70+digit in the VRAM queue while suppressing leading zeroes.
Writes a byte to zero-page offset 0x8E plus index, stores the index at 0xFEA3, and halts at an invalid opcode boundary.
Blanks rendering, uploads 2 or 20 PPU nametable streams from table 0xB814 via ppu_upload_zp80_stream_immediate, and restores PPU_MASK.
Entry wrapper that transfers control directly to boss state dispatcher at 0xB2AA.
Switches UNROM PRG bank back to bank 6 via unrom_select_bank_index(6) and returns.
Dispatches boss state 0x60 through the inline jump table at 0xB2AA via inline_jump_table_dispatch.
Increments actor phase timer 0x55 and resets boss state 0x60 to zero every 8 ticks.
Every 8 frames, selects boss movement state 1-4 in 0x60 based on actor 0x0328/0x0348 position relative to 0x0320/0x0340.
Checks boss attack alignment at 0xB3E2/0xB3FC and moves actor Y 0x0348 up by 2 or switches state 0x60 to 3/4 near top edge.
Moves actor Y 0x0348 down by 2 while checking 0xB3E2/0xB3FC alignment and table 0xB4C9 stop positions.
Moves actor X 0x0328 left by 2 while checking 0xB3E2/0xB438 alignment and table 0xB4C9 stop positions.
Boss patrol entry at 0xB383 whose body merges into adjacent 0xB39B-0xB438 alignment blocks.
Sets actor slot index 0x89 to 8 and tests whether actor Y 0x0348 equals 0x20 before adjacent alignment checks.
Every 8 frames, tests sprite ID and horizontal alignment within 48 pixels to set boss attack state 6-9 in 0x60.
Checks sprite ID match against table 0xB4C9 and horizontal proximity within 48 pixels to select attack state 6-9.
Computes horizontal distance between 0x0328 and 0x0320 and returns boss attack state 6-9 if within 48 pixels, else 0.
Computes vertical distance between 0x0348 and 0x0340 and returns boss attack state 6-9 if within 64 pixels, else 0.
Runs alignment check 0xB3E2(4) and steps actor Y 0x0348 up by 2 until below 0x12, resetting state 0x60 to 0.
Runs alignment check 0xB3E2(6) and steps actor Y 0x0348 down by 2 until reaching 0xDF, resetting state 0x60 to 0.
Runs alignment check 0xB3E2(0) and steps actor X 0x0328 left by 2 until reaching 0x21, then switches state 0x60.
Runs alignment check 0xB3E2(2) and steps actor X 0x0328 right by 2 until reaching 0x95, then switches state 0x60.
Ticks both boss actor slots via 0xB4E3 and restores UNROM bank 6.
Iterates active boss actor slots 0 and 1 in 0x0308 and dispatches each through 0xB4F7.
Selects state 0x60 or 0x56 for actor slot g_zp_ptr1, overrides to state 2 on X proximity within 8 pixels, and dispatches via inline_jump_tab
Shifts g_sram_46b5 left and zero-page offset 0x4C right before hitting an invalid-instruction halt.
Every 128 frames, toggles the sprite ID of slot g_zp_ptr1 in 0x0308 between 0x5F and 0x62.
Steps actor slot g_zp_ptr1 vertically toward Y=0x80 while toggling walk sprite IDs and resets state when centered.
Increments actor Y coordinate in 0x0348 and toggles its sprite ID between 0x61 and 0x62 when anim_gate is zero.
Decrements actor Y coordinate in 0x0348 and toggles its sprite ID between 0x5F and 0x60 when anim_gate is zero.
Steps actor slot g_zp_ptr1 vertically toward player Y 0x0340 and sets state 0x56 or 0x60 to 1.
Runs periodic SFX 9 and boss state dispatch at 0xB5C0, then restores UNROM bank 6.
Triggers SFX 9 every 16 frames and dispatches boss state 0x60 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.
Initializes countdown timers 0x55-0x57 to 0x7F and advances boss state 0x60.
Spawns, animates, and times out boss minion/projectile slots in 0x0308 using timers 0x55-0x57 and 0x42.
Advances bounded actor X movement via 0xB6AF and restores UNROM bank 6.
Advances actor X coordinate 0x0328 on table-masked frames, advancing state 0x60 at X=0x58 and clamping at X=0x88.
Runs orbiting boss state setup and dispatch at 0xB6D6, then restores UNROM bank 6.
Increments phase 0x55, sets orbit origin (0x8F, 0x8E) to (0x28, 0x68) with slot 1, and dispatches state 0x60 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.
Expands radii for orbiting sprites 1-6 (playing SFX 0x19 on step 1) and advances state 0x60 when step 0x55 reaches 16.
Advances state 0x60 when orbit phase 0x55 reaches 32, otherwise updates polar sprite slots start_slot..6.
Decrements shared orbit angle 0x55 by 2 and updates polar sprite positions for slots start_slot..6 until angle reaches 0xE2.
Advances state 0x60 when orbit angle 0x55 reaches zero, otherwise updates polar positions for slots start_slot..6.
Shrinks orbit radii in 0xB8+slot for slots start_slot..6, updates polar coordinates, and advances state 0x60 at step 16.
Clears actor sprite IDs from start_slot to 6 in 0x0308 and resets state 0x60 and angle 0x55 when 0x55 equals 0x30.
Selects boss sprite ID 0x5B, 0x5C, or 0x5D in 0x0308 based on the signed range of angle/offset 0x55.
Computes sine/cosine screen coordinates around (0x8F, 0x8E) for an orbiting sprite slot and increments its angle.
Runs bomb-dropping boss update at 0xB7CF and restores UNROM bank 6.
Spawns a 0x54 projectile with SFX 0x0F when player X aligns with actor Y on 128-tick intervals, then dispatches state 0x60.
Initializes projectile slot under 0x16 as sprite 0x54 with SFX 0x0F, increments timer 0x57, and dispatches state 0x60.
Cycles sprite via 0xBC11(3), steps X 0x0328 left every 4 frames until transition to state 2, and spawns barrage shots.
Cycles sprite via 0xBC11(3), steps X 0x0328 right every 4 frames until X=0x30 (state 3), and spawns barrage shots.
Steps barrage sequence index 0x55 every 16 frames to spawn projectiles at Y=0x70 or 0x90 until timer 0x56 hits 64.
Runs four-sprite drift and state dispatch at 0xB8C0, then restores UNROM bank 6.
Every 8 frames, offsets sprite Y slots 0x0351-0x0353 and 0x0355, then dispatches boss state 0x60 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.
Sets boss state 0x60 to 1 or 2 by comparing actor Y 0x0348 against player X 0x35 and vertical bounds 0x18-0xD6.
Moves actor Y 0x0348 up by 2, animates sprite via 0xBC11(0), and sets state 0x60 to 3 if Y matches table 0xB976.
Moves actor Y 0x0348 down by 2, animating sprite 0x0308 and spawning projectiles when Y wraps or aligns with 0xB976.
Fires projectiles and animates sprite 0x0308 while actor Y 0x0348 matches table 0xB976, or resets state 0x60.
Decrements boss sprite ID 0x0308 and wraps from 0x4E back to 0x50.
Updates four boss shot timers via 0xB983 and restores UNROM bank 6.
Updates 4 projectile sprite timers at 0x0310/0x55-0x58 and dispatches boss state 0x60 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.
Advances projectile sprite animation across remaining slots 0x0310+slot_index..3 and dispatches state 0x60 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.
Sets boss state 0x60 to 1 or 2 by comparing actor Y 0x0348 against player X 0x35 and vertical bounds 0x48-0xC6.
Moves actor Y 0x0348 up by 2, switches to sprite 0x48 and state 3 on table 0xBA4A stop match, or animates via 0xBC11(2).
Advances actor Y 0x0348 by 2 against stop table 0xBA4A or aims and fires a tracked projectile with SFX 0x17.
Every 32 frames, aims at the player and spawns a projectile in 0x0310-0x0313 with SFX 0x17 when angle is in 4..12.
Computes signed X/Y deltas between actor (0x0328, 0x0348) and player (0x0320+8, 0x0340) and returns an aim angle from table 0xBAB6.
Allocates a free projectile slot in 0x0310-0x0315, plays SFX 7, positions it from 0xBC09, and packs its direction nibble into 0x61-0x63.
Positions projectile slot 0x8B horizontally relative to parent_slot, sets sprite 0x28, and packs direction nibble 0x8A into 0x61-0x63.
Every 8 frames, increments boss sprite ID 0x0308 and wraps it using limit/reset bounds from table 0xBC29.
Updates twin turret tracking and firing via 0xBC37 and restores UNROM bank 6.
Tracks player X 0x35 for sprite slots 8-9 within 0xBCCB bounds and selects firing direction from 0xBCCB every 16 frames.
Writes a metasprite ID directly into the sprite ID table at 0x0300 + slot_index.
Bank-2 stub that calls the fixed-bank vec_irq_noop routine and returns.
Invokes the external 0x2020 subroutine twice in succession and returns.
Executes boss/cutscene state dispatch at 0xB019 and restores UNROM bank 6.
Dispatches boss/cutscene state 0x60 through the inline jump table at 0xB019 via inline_jump_table_dispatch.
Checks sprite frame/position trigger to advance state 0x60 with SFX 0x7D, and periodically queues a 21-byte VRAM packet at 0x0740.
Streams 6 intro packets every 4 frames and initializes Snake's starting health (0x96), rank (1), and room mode (3) at step 16.
Loops through 6 packet offsets (0-10 step 2) calling 0xB0E5 and update_bank3_sprite_graphics before restoring bank 6.
Loads a bank-2 packet by unscaled index into the 0x0740 VRAM queue and copies its 0xFF-terminated payload.
Loads a bank-2 packet by pre-doubled table_offset into 0x0740 and copies its 0xFF-terminated payload.
Decodes a destination pointer from g_zp_ptr0 at start_offset and copies 0xFF-terminated bytes into 0x0702 or target memory.
When dialog/menu mode 0x07E0 is below 4, queues two 14-byte zeroed VRAM clear packets at 0x0740 and 0x0752 using 0xBECF coordinates.
Handles Up/Down/A/B joypad1 edge inputs for the 3-option menu cursor 0x4B with selection/move sound effects.
Builds three 4-byte VRAM transfer packets at 0x0740 for menu mode 0 or looks up mode-indexed nametable coordinates in 0xBECF.
Queues three 4-byte VRAM packets using ppu_addr_hi, advances menu step 0x07E0, and restores display/state when step reaches 10.
Checks if player is in (0x60..0xAF, 0x88) with action != 0x0D to play sound 0x1D via switch_bank6_and_play_sound and set room init mode 0x2C
Updates sprite X 0x0320 from player Y 0x36 + 5, clears room init mode 0x2C at 0x58, decrements 0x36, and restores bank 6.
Increments timer 0x51 to animate sprite 0x0300 via table 0xBFFC, transitions game mode 0x10 to 6 on wrap, and selects bank 6.
